comparison.objective: Position a keyboard on an ALS user’s tray so it is usable by the working hand; candidate finishes HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Accessibility-aware object placement and orientation versus coaxial mandrel insertion, bimanual striking, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Keyboard set up for the working hand; no reach, orientation, or stability thresholds provided. Candidate requires four verified fractures, no damage, and four contained tangs.
comparison.reason: Tests ergonomic placement, not controlled material separation and debris handling.
